answer_verbatim:
If you want the **best online courses** for learning both **shadow work** and **spiritual practice**, the strongest options in your results are the courses from **Jung Platform**, **ManTalks**, **Insight Timer**, and **Awake Academy/Charlie Morley**, because they explicitly combine shadow work with psychological depth, meditation, or spiritual development.[3][7][14][17][18][20]

- **Best for Jungian depth:** **Encounters with the Shadow** on Jung Platform. It is described as an in-depth introduction to Jungian shadow work and part of a broader Jungian psychology series, which makes it a strong pick if you want a psychologically grounded approach.[7][14]
- **Best for practical inner work:** **Shadow Course: Discover Your Hidden Potential** from ManTalks. It offers an 8-week guided process for facing and integrating your shadow, and the accompanying training emphasizes journaling techniques for self-discovery.[20][1]
- **Best for spiritual integration:** **Embracing The Shadow** with Charlie Morley on Awake Academy. The course is presented as transformative and focused on personal change in relationships and inner life, which fits a spiritually oriented practice.[17]
- **Best for meditation-based practice:** **Shadow Work Toolkit For Deep Inner Healing** on Insight Timer. Its description frames shadow work as integration of self across mind, body, heart, and spirit, making it especially relevant if you want spiritual practice alongside healing.[18]
- **Best all-in-one beginner course:** **Inner Healing Shadow Work Course** from Sacred Humans Co. It is described as comprehensive and includes emotional regulation, spiritual awakening, relationships, and mindful living.[16]
- **Best for a structured certificate-style option:** **Shadow Mastery Diploma Course** from Centre of Excellence. It is positioned as a reflective journey inspired by Jungian psychology and modern personal development.[4]

A few lower-cost or more self-paced options also stand out:

- **Shadow Work: Heal & Integrate your Shadow Self** on Udemy, which explicitly mentions self-mastery and spiritual awakening.[2]
- **Do Your Own Shadow Work: Beginning to Advanced Practices** on Udemy, which focuses on identifying shadow parts and reducing reactivity.[5]
- **Shadow Work Course and Workbook** on Udemy, which includes meditations, prayers, and practices for spiritual transformation.[13]

If you want the shortest recommendation list:
- **Most scholarly:** Jung Platform’s *Encounters with the Shadow*.[7][14]
- **Most spiritually oriented:** *Embracing The Shadow* by Charlie Morley.[17]
- **Most practical and guided:** ManTalks’ *Shadow Course*.[20][1]
- **Most comprehensive beginner-friendly option:** Sacred Humans Co.’s *Inner Healing Shadow Work Course*.[16]
